column1: # Calibration pilot (2026-10-22): where does the fire-sale bank's transition sit in
# reserves r and fire-sale discount d at Celsius-matched concentration (sigma 2.5)?
# F9 (docs/pilot_map.md) found a floor of liquidity failures at mid and high theta
# at r 0.05, d 0.6: period-1 capacity r + (1 - d)(1 - r + e) = 0.454 of deposits,
# and the median bank's largest depositor holds 38% of it. This scan separates the
# liquidity floor (should respond to d) from the theta-sorted insolvency failures
# (should respond to r through theta_L and A*).
# Fixed: e 0.06, R(theta) = 1.0 + 0.4 theta, R_stay 1.1, private theta signal s 0.10
# (F9's middle noise), k 6, p 0.05, q 0, alpha 0.1, mu 0.5, lambda (0.1, 0.9).
# theta_L (fails with no withdrawals) = (0.1 - e) / (0.4 (1 - r + e)): 0.099 / 0.104 / 0.116.
# Single-cell arms at seed offset 1000: all twelve share GEN_SEED 1001, so the same five
# banks and the same theta run for run; cal-r05-d60 reruns p3-s25-theta-s10 exactly
# (and r10, r20). Report per arm: P(run), liquidity share of failures, P(run | theta > 0.4).
# Use: place the sweep's r and d levels where liquidity failures are neither 0 nor the floor.
